{{Quote|&hellip;as for the Celanon campaign, Darth Marr is coordinating the joint armada with minimal losses.|Moff Pyron|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Celanon campaign''' was a military campaign that occurred at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Darth Marr]] commanded the Empire's joint armada at Celanon with minimal losses, and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron]] reported on the campaign to [[Darth Nox]].
